title: Anchorage platform bento
description: A centred heading and short paragraph over a narrow bento of charcoal-to-black panels: two tall cards with big two-line titles and a product slot each, then one wide card pairing a large title with a money figure in an outlined pill (cobalt icon tile) and a column of round check pills. A soft blue glow blooms at the right edge. The figure counts up and the check pills slide in one after another as the card scrolls into view.
notes: each tall card has a media slot (about 11:10); empty, it shows a bordered token-coloured placeholder
the check pills' reveal is CSS scroll-driven (static HTML shows them in place); the count-up needs JavaScript
best on dark themes: the panels fade from card to the page background
